scenes.text: Hi MDC! I'm Finn, and this is the Civic Action Scorecard Planner. It makes your scorecard easy. Here's the quick tour!
All 124 actions, right here. Five categories, and four phases that pace your whole year.
Finished something? Check it off! Your points land instantly, and the meter shows how close the next award is.
Now set a goal. Say, Silver by finals week. The planner tells you the weekly pace, and whether you're on track.
Like to map things out? Hit Plan! It shows up in light blue, so you can see exactly where your plan takes you.
Open any action, and everything's right there. What to submit, plus the three reflection questions. Draft right here, and the counter turns green when you've written enough.
Ready to submit? Hit Open Engage MDC. It drops you on that exact action, one click from Add Impact. And every answer has its own copy button. Your words, straight into the form.
scenes.caption: Ready to submit? Hit Open EngageMDC. It drops you on that exact action, one click from Add Impact. And every answer has its own copy button. Your words, straight into the form.

scenes.text: One more thing. Put it on your phone! It works like an app, even offline, and your progress follows you everywhere.
That's the whole loop! Plan it here. Do it out there. Prove it in Engage MDC. Find it at civic action planner dot github dot I O. See you out there, Sharks!
